name: Launch slips six months
narrative: A problem on another payload pushes your launch six months right. Standing army costs accrue.
survived: Your budget reserve absorbed the slip without descoping anything.
failed: With no budget reserve, the overrun forced the project to cancel an instrument.

name: Solar array underperforms
narrative: Post-deployment telemetry shows the array producing 7% less than predicted.
survived: Your power margin covered the shortfall. All instruments stayed online.
failed: Instruments were shed to stay within the power budget. Science return dropped.

name: Instrument thermal anomaly
narrative: A detector runs hotter than designed. The workaround is a heater duty cycle that costs extra power.
survived: Enough power margin existed to run the heater workaround. The instrument was saved.
failed: No power available for the workaround. The instrument was permanently lost.

name: Ground station contention
narrative: A flagship mission takes priority on the ground network. Your contact time is cut by 20%.
survived: Your downlink margin absorbed the cut. No data was lost.
failed: Onboard storage filled and the oldest observations were overwritten before downlink.

name: Micrometeoroid strike
narrative: A particle punches through one array wing, permanently reducing output by 5%.
survived: Margin covered the loss. Operations continued normally.
failed: Power dropped below the instrument load. The spacecraft entered safe mode.

name: Mid-development budget cut
narrative: An agency-wide rebalance removes 10% of your remaining development funding.
survived: Reserves absorbed the cut. The mission flew as designed.
failed: An instrument was descoped to fit the reduced budget.

name: Reaction wheel failure
narrative: A reaction wheel seizes in year three. Pointing stability degrades sharply.
survived: The redundant wheel took over. Pointing performance was unaffected.
failed: Without a spare wheel, fine-pointing instruments were unusable for the rest of the mission.
